milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch fence gate is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 4), directly ahead of the player. Target is set to the gate center with max_distance=5 (generous for a find task) and facing_tolerance=60 degrees. The player must navigate close to and look toward the gate to confirm they've found it.

Uses inventory_has because mining granite_wall with a pickaxe drops the granite_wall item into the player's inventory. The granite wall blocks are inside the enclosure behind the birch fence gate at z=7. A wooden pickaxe (mining level 0) is sufficient to mine granite (stone-type block). The player must collect at least 1.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The red nether brick wall is at spawn-relative (7-10, 0-2, 3), to the right side of the compound. Target is set to the center of the wall structure at (8, 1, 3) with max_distance=8 (generous since the player approaches from spawn at origin) and facing_tolerance=60 degrees to confirm visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because mining purple_concrete with a pickaxe drops the purple_concrete item into the player's inventory. The purple concrete blocks are at spawn-relative (8-10, 0-1, 4), adjacent to the red nether brick wall. A wooden pickaxe is sufficient to mine concrete. The player must collect at least 1.
